records.title: ProGen2: Exploring the Boundaries of Protein Language Models
records.reason: ProGen2 models protein sequences for protein engineering and fitness prediction; the large model scale is for a non-LLM scientific application, with no inference-system efficiency method.

records.title: Learning Delays in Spiking Neural Networks using Dilated Convolutions with Learnable Spacings
records.reason: The learned synaptic delays improve spiking-neural-network speech/time-series recognition; the target is a non-LLM SNN model and its training algorithm, not LLM inference or serving.

records.title: Not All Directions Matter: Towards Structured and Task-Aware Low-Rank Model Adaptation
records.reason: StructLoRA improves adaptation quality with training-only modules and explicitly reports zero additional inference cost; it is a training/adaptation method rather than an inference-efficiency contribution.

records.title: Toward Consistent World Models with Multi-Token Prediction and Latent Semantic Enhancement
records.reason: The paper studies latent world-model representation consistency with multi-token prediction and synthetic/ride data; the abstract does not connect the method to faster speculative inference or serving efficiency.

records.title: ABPolicy: Asynchronous B-Spline Flow Policy for Real-Time and Smooth Robotic Manipulation
records.reason: Asynchronous inference and real-time updates target robotic VLA policy responsiveness, but the work is an application-specific manipulation policy and does not establish LLM serving gains.

records.title: ACARIS: Attempting to Improve Conversational AI and Human Social Skills using User Embeddings
records.reason: The DOI resolver/official IEEE publisher page did not yield a verifiable abstract in this run; only third-party indexed material was found, which was not used as primary evidence.

records.title: Re2: Unlocking LLM Reasoning via Reinforcement Learning with Re-solving
records.reason: Re-solving is an RLVR reasoning-training behavior and test-time reasoning-quality technique; the abstract emphasizes accuracy and additional test-time samples rather than reduced serving cost.

records.title: Are Audio-Language Models Listening? Audio-Specialist Heads for Adaptive Audio Steering
records.reason: Audio-specialist heads steer audio-language model outputs to improve speech understanding accuracy; the contribution is modality grounding/quality, not inference efficiency.

records.title: EvoIdeator: Evolving Scientific Ideas through Checklist-Grounded Reinforcement Learning
records.reason: EvoIdeator trains a Qwen3-4B policy for scientific ideation with feedback; the abstract reports quality/generalization rather than serving or inference efficiency.

records.title: Magellan: Autonomous Discovery of Novel Compiler Optimization Heuristics with AlphaEvolve
records.reason: The method synthesizes deployable compiler-pass heuristics and evaluates end-to-end compiler performance, including XLA auto-sharding for real model graphs; this is a concrete compiler/runtime optimization path relevant to efficient ML execution.

records.title: CSSBench: Evaluating the Safety of Lightweight LLMs against Chinese-Specific Adversarial Patterns
records.reason: CSSBench evaluates Chinese adversarial safety and over-refusal in lightweight LLMs; it is a safety benchmark, not a serving/performance optimization.

records.title: VAEVQ: Enhancing Discrete Visual Tokenization through Variational Modeling
records.reason: The work improves visual-token quantization/codebook utilization for generative models; compressed visual tokens may affect inference cost, but the abstract reports representation quality rather than measured LLM/runtime efficiency.

records.title: Multi-Grid Tensorized Fourier Neural Operator for High-Resolution PDEs
records.reason: MG-TFNO compresses Fourier neural operators for high-resolution PDE simulation; its target is PDE operator learning rather than LLM inference or serving.

records.title: From Articulated Kinematics to Routed Visual Control for Action-Conditioned Surgical Video Generation
records.reason: Hierarchical sparse routing and budgeted inference reduce latency for surgical video generation, but this is a specialized visual-generation application rather than LLM inference/serving.

records.title: Toward Agentic Environments: GenAI and the Convergence of AI, Sustainability, and Human-Centric Spaces
records.reason: This conceptual study proposes sustainable, human-centric GenAI environments and edge deployment recommendations; it does not present a concrete inference-system method or evaluation.

records.title: Agent Memory Distillation: Empowering Small LLM Agents with Hierarchical Teacher Memory
records.reason: AMD gives small LLM agents hierarchical, training-free teacher memory to improve tool-use success, but the abstract does not establish lower latency, memory use, or serving cost; retained as a plausible small-model deployment connection.

records.title: CF-VLA: Efficient Coarse-to-Fine Action Generation for Vision-Language-Action Policies
records.reason: CF-VLA restructures flow-based VLA action generation into an action-aware coarse initialization followed by one local refinement. The v4 primary text reports lower action-sampling latency with comparable task success under a much smaller inference budget. This is a robotics/VLA workload, so transfer to general LLM serving is not established; retain it as an adjacent efficient multimodal inference candidate for later Research review.

records.title: Just Noticeable Difference Modeling for Deep Visual Features
records.reason: FeatJND guides token-wise dynamic quantization of deep visual features under constrained resources; it is a vision-feature compression technique with no stated LLM inference/serving evaluation.

records.title: SimMerge: Learning to Select Merge Operators from Similarity Signals
records.reason: SimMerge avoids iterative merge-and-evaluate searches using inexpensive model-similarity signals, reducing model-development evaluation cost for LLM composition; the abstract does not show inference-serving/runtime gains, so this is retained for root review.

records.title: A Novel Execution Time Prediction Scheme for Efficient Physical AI Resource Management
records.reason: CARE-D predicts execution time and calibrates resource use for heterogeneous physical-AI workloads; the official MDPI body describes manufacturing simulations and production forecasting, not LLM serving, so this remains outside the target domain.
